Route25_SeaCottage_Text_AbandonedPC.en: The screen is dead. A note says:\nGone to the islands. - BILL
Route25_SeaCottage_Text_AbandonedPC.fr: L'écran est éteint. Une note dit :\nParti aux îles. - LÉO

Route25_SeaCottage_Text_FoundSSTicket.en: {PLAYER} got an S.S. TICKET\nfrom the TEAM ONYBRIS GRUNT!
Route25_SeaCottage_Text_FoundSSTicket.fr: {PLAYER} a reçu un TICKET S.S.\ndu SBIRE de la TEAM ONYBRIS !

Route25_SeaCottage_Text_GruntADrops.en: GRUNT: Argh! Take this stupid\npass! The boss wanted it for the\pship, but I'm done with this job!
Route25_SeaCottage_Text_GruntADrops.fr: SBIRE : Argh ! Prends ce satané\npass ! Le boss le voulait pour le\lbateau, mais j'en ai fini avec ce\nboulot !

Route25_SeaCottage_Text_GruntAIntro.en: GRUNT: You think you can beat me\non your own, kid?
Route25_SeaCottage_Text_GruntAIntro.fr: SBIRE : Tu crois pouvoir me battre\ntout seul ?

Route25_SeaCottage_Text_GruntBDown.en: GRUNT: Gaah! Washed out!\nI'm not staying for this!
Route25_SeaCottage_Text_GruntBDown.fr: SBIRE : Gaah ! Lessivé !\nJe reste pas pour ça !

Route25_SeaCottage_Text_GruntsAppear.en: GRUNT: Tch! How did you find us?\pGRUNT: The boss said nobody would\nlook in this dump!
Route25_SeaCottage_Text_GruntsAppear.fr: SBIRE : Tch ! Comment tu nous as\ntrouvés ?\pSBIRE : Le boss disait que\npersonne ne viendrait dans ce trou !

Route25_SeaCottage_Text_MistyBattle.en: MISTY: STARMIE, go!\nHit him with WATER GUN!
Route25_SeaCottage_Text_MistyBattle.fr: ONDINE : STAROSS, go !\nFrappe-le avec PISTOLET À O !

Route25_SeaCottage_Text_MistyBye.en: MISTY: The tide always comes back.\nSo do I. Take care, {PLAYER}.
Route25_SeaCottage_Text_MistyBye.fr: ONDINE : La marée revient toujours.\nMoi aussi. Prends soin de toi,\l{PLAYER}.

Route25_SeaCottage_Text_MistyEnd1.en: MISTY: I watched the sky go quiet\non the day you let JIRACHI go.\pA wish is lighter when it is\ngiven away. Take this, it's from\lthe cold water where I grew up.
Route25_SeaCottage_Text_MistyEnd1.fr: ONDINE : J'ai vu le ciel se taire\nle jour où t'as laissé partir\lJIRACHI.\pUn vœu est plus léger quand on le\ndonne. Prends ça, il vient de l'eau\lfroide où j'ai grandi.

Route25_SeaCottage_Text_MistyEnd2.en: MISTY: No more POKé BALLS. My\nWATER POKéMON laugh about it.\pNobody is a trophy now. Good.\nKeep these ready, you will need\lthem for the Park.
Route25_SeaCottage_Text_MistyEnd2.fr: ONDINE : Plus de POKé BALLS. Mes\nPOKéMON EAU en rient.\pPlus personne n'est un trophée.\nBien. Garde-les prêts, tu en auras\lbesoin pour le Parc.

Route25_SeaCottage_Text_MistyEnd3.en: MISTY: You hold the six legends.\nI do not know whether to cheer.\pPower asks for care. Take these\nand use them for your friends,\lnot for yourself.
Route25_SeaCottage_Text_MistyEnd3.fr: ONDINE : Tu possèdes les six\nlégendes. Je sais pas s'il faut\lse réjouir.\pLa puissance demande des égards.\nPrends ça et utilise-le pour tes\lamis, pas pour toi.

Route25_SeaCottage_Text_MistyFarewell.en: MISTY: Nice work. You have guts.\pYou really do remind me of a\nfriend of mine. He would have\pcharged in just the same.\pThe S.S. ANNE docks at APATIA.\nI'll see you around. Good luck!
Route25_SeaCottage_Text_MistyFarewell.fr:
ONDINE : Beau travail. T'as du
cran.\pTu me rappelles vraiment un ami à
moi. Il aurait foncé de la même\lfaçon.\pLe S.S. ANNE accoste à APATIA. À
bientôt. Bonne chance !

Route25_SeaCottage_Text_MistySplit.en: MISTY: I'll take the one on the\nright. You take the left!
Route25_SeaCottage_Text_MistySplit.fr: ONDINE : Je prends celui de droite.\nToi, celui de gauche !

Route25_SeaCottage_Text_MistyWhisper.en: MISTY: Careful. I can hear them\nbreathing behind those machines.
Route25_SeaCottage_Text_MistyWhisper.fr: ONDINE : Prudence. Je les entends\nrespirer derrière ces machines.
